title: NLP parses a trailing fourth-quarter context
inputs: POST /nlp/parse with "Down 5 with 2:00 left in the 4th".
expected: The parser returns margin -5, period 4 and 120 seconds, with no defaulted or rejected fields.
comment: The parser read the prompt as down five in Q4 with 120 seconds left. No fields were defaulted or rejected.
description:
Use-case coverage: UC45, UC50.

Scope: local parser/API tests in backend/tests/test_nlp_parser.py; no browser or ranking result is claimed.

Steps:
1. Run the pinned backend test environment.
2. POST /nlp/parse with "Down 5 with 2:00 left in the 4th".
3. Inspect test_fully_parsed_prompt_reports_no_defaulted_fields and compare the result.

Expected result: The parser returns margin -5, period 4 and 120 seconds, with no defaulted or rejected fields.

Evidence: docs/assignment-1-revision/tests/backend-junit.xml.
